question: If the cost price is 94% of the selling price, then find the profit percentage.
solution:
Given:

The cost price is 94% of the selling price

Formula Used:

Profit = S.P. - C.P.

Profit % = Profit/C.P. × 100

Calculations:

Let the Selling Price is 100x.

Then the Cost price = 94% of 100x

= 94x

⇒ Profit = 100x - 94x = 6x

⇒ Profit % = (6x/94x) × 100

⇒ Profit % = 6.4%

**∴ The profit percentage is 6.4%.**
